description: This source file provides utility functions for working with FX graphs in PyTorch's AOTAutograd system, especially handling joint graphs with descriptors for differentiable inputs, outputs, tangents, parameters, and buffers. It includes functions for retrieving nodes associated with inputs, outputs, and parameters based on descriptors and their FQNs, as well as handling subclasses not currently supported.

methods.name: NoReturn _raise_autograd_subclass_not_implemented( n: fx.Node, desc: Union[AOTInput, AOTOutput] )
methods.description: Raises a RuntimeError indicating subclasses are not supported in this context.

methods.name: dict[DifferentiableAOTInput,tuple[fx.Node,Optional[fx.Node]]] get_all_input_and_grad_nodes( g: fx.Graph, )
methods.description: Returns a mapping from differentiable AOT inputs to their corresponding nodes and gradient nodes in a FX graph.

methods.name: dict[DifferentiableAOTOutput,tuple[fx.Node,Optional[fx.Node]]] get_all_output_and_tangent_nodes( g: fx.Graph, )
methods.description: Returns a mapping from differentiable AOT outputs to their corresponding nodes and tangent nodes in a FX graph.

methods.name: dict[ParamAOTInput,tuple[fx.Node,Optional[fx.Node]]] get_param_and_grad_nodes( graph: fx.Graph, )
methods.description: Filters input-gradient pairs to extract only parameter descriptors and their nodes.

methods.name: dict[PlainAOTInput,tuple[fx.Node,Optional[fx.Node]]] get_plain_input_and_grad_nodes( graph: fx.Graph, )
methods.description: Filters input-gradient pairs for plain AOT inputs.

methods.name: dict[PlainAOTOutput,tuple[fx.Node,Optional[fx.Node]]] get_plain_output_and_tangent_nodes( graph: fx.Graph, )
methods.description: Filters output-tangent pairs for plain AOT outputs.

methods.name: NoReturn _raise_fqn_subclass_not_implemented( n: fx.Node, desc: Union[AOTInput, AOTOutput] )
methods.description: Raises a RuntimeError indicating FQN subclasses are not supported.

methods.name: dict[str,fx.Node] get_named_param_nodes(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Returns a dict mapping parameter FQNs to FX nodes.

methods.name: dict[str,fx.Node] get_named_buffer_nodes(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Returns a dict mapping buffer FQNs to FX nodes.

methods.name: list[fx.Node] get_param_nodes(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Returns a list of parameter FX nodes in order.

methods.name: list[fx.Node] get_buffer_nodes(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Returns a list of buffer FX nodes in order.
